To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the English system is one in which a complex and evolving mix of policy initiatives is directed at the achievement and attainment of particular groups, with the aim of improving their educational outcomes.
, in England, the policy landscape has been one of ‘tinkering’ rather than ‘transforming’; of incremental rather than radical change; of ‘more’ rather than ‘different’.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the policy landscape is complex, and that there is a need to be careful in identifying the precise policy mechanisms that are most likely to impact upon educational inequalities.
